name: AutoForge
notes:
**AutoForge 0.3.4**

- **New name: AutoForge.** Your workflows and credentials stay where they are (`%APPDATA%\FlowForge`), so installing over the old version keeps everything.
- **Approve videos from your phone.** The AI Story Shorts workflow emails you a link to watch the new Short and tap Approve or Reject; it uploads only when you approve. The link works from anywhere while your PC is on. There is also a new Approvals tab in the app.
- **Groq for AI steps.** Basic LLM Chain can use Groq (new "Groq API" credential); the AI Story Shorts template now writes and checks stories with Groq.
- **Gemini:** retired models are skipped automatically.
- **Make Video:** stock clips come from Coverr; a huge Timeout no longer fails; a clear message when MoneyPrinterTurbo is not running; 3 retries a minute apart.
- **iPhone:** unsigned FlowForge.ipa for sideloading with AltStore or Sideloadly. Android APK and Windows installer included.

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly

downloads.label: Android app (.apk)
downloads.requirements: Android 7 or newer - allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser
